title: Stateful Testing for Deep Learning Compilers
abstract: arXiv:2610.22003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern deep learning compilers compile models lazily and cache artifacts across invocations. Retained compiler state can make a later invocation incorrect even when it is correct in isolation. An analysis of 26 publicly reported issues in PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow shows that detecting such bugs requires sequences that first establish compiler state and then expose a failure. We present Rondo, a stateful testing method that represents each test case as a model paired with an invocation sequence. Rondo mutates invocation sequences and uses a Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler guided by compilation behavior to favor rarely observed behaviors. Its three-way differential oracle compares execution without compilation, compiled execution with compiler state reset, and compiled execution with state retained. It confirms stateful bugs by replaying the same invocation with state retained and reset while preserving inputs and program state, then

translated_title: 面向深度学习编译器的有状态测试
translated_abstract: 现代深度学习编译器采用惰性编译方式，并在多次调用之间缓存编译产物。保留的编译器状态可能导致后续调用产生错误结果，即使该调用在单独执行时是正确的。对 PyTorch、JAX 和 TensorFlow 中 26 个公开报告问题的分析表明，检测此类缺陷需要先建立编译器状态、再暴露故障的调用序列。我们提出了 Rondo，一种有状态测试方法，它将每个测试用例表示为一个模型与一个调用序列的组合。Rondo 对调用序列进行变异，并使用由编译行为引导的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样器，以偏向较少被观察到的行为。其三路差分测试预言机比较三种执行方式：不编译直接执行、重置编译器状态后的编译执行，以及保留编译器状态时的编译执行。它通过在保留状态与重置状态两种条件下重放相同调用（同时保持输入和程序状态不变）来确认有状态缺陷，然后……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出面向深度学习编译器的有状态测试方法 Rondo，通过将模型与调用序列配对、利用编译行为引导的 MCMC 采样进行序列变异，并结合三路差分预言机，检测由编译器保留状态引发且在单独执行时无法复现的缺陷。
